rules.name: Native control continuity
rules.body: Preserve Streamlit control shapes and states unless an existing app override specifies otherwise.

dos: Do keep input, controls and output comparisons together.
Do label sample provenance, settings and measured results.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and digital exports.
donts: Don't present synthetic demonstrations as personal training evidence.
Don't report unexecuted work as completed.
Don't claim screenshot verification from source inspection or AppTest.
